purpose: Bounded checkpoint/release diagnosis, not optimization or Unity compilation qualification.

methodology.edits: Each case changes the same one source line. Private-library case additionally changes the first byte of 128 existing 256-byte Library files; minimal case changes none.
methodology.priorEvidence: Reuses the completed large Unity run; no large-project rerun.
methodology.instrumentedDistribution: Scratch Git/Runtime assemblies only; original product source and original Unity fixture unchanged.
limits: Single ordered run per case, no cache clearing or statistical confidence.
Instrumentation logging overhead is included and not independently quantified.
A roughly 4.4-second diagnostic fence microprobe overlapped the first case at 07:50:01 UTC; no isolated absolute SLA is claimed.
Tiny fixture demonstrates mechanisms; its wall times must not be extrapolated to Unity or a larger project.
Git span includes process startup and I/O, not just attribute CPU time.
Non-Git inspection residual is a phase remainder, not measured provider-lock time.
Provider inventory counters cover process lifetime, not individual checkpoint/release intervals.
Nested Runtime spans and event stages overlap source/seal phases; do not sum across parent/child tables.

instrumentation.purpose: diagnostic-only scratch assemblies; no product source changes
instrumentation.timingSemantics: spans overlap and nest; aggregate inventory ticks do not add to parent spans; file logging failures swallowed; inventory uses counters only and flushes on normal exit

aCheckpoint.intervalSemantics: Inspection starts inferred from recorded completion minus monotonic elapsed; logger/write overhead and other stages remain unattributed.

fenceMembershipProbe.method: Real NTFS one-byte files and FileStream.Name; exact SamePath/Any/File.Exists body with non-atomic diagnostic comparison counter; 32-file warmup then one pass per size; files disposed and deleted after each pass
